description: Get what CLOUDFLARE currently says about a domain's zone (status, paused, its nameservers, activation date) rather than what Porkbun's queue row remembers. These drift: if someone repoints the nameservers elsewhere after the move, the Porkbun row still says done while Cloudflare has stopped serving the domain. The response includes the live public nameservers and a `nameserversDrifted` boolean so you don't have to diff them yourself.

domain.description: Domain whose Cloudflare zone to inspect.

name: get_cloudflare_zone
title: Get Cloudflare Zone
